steps.title: Check current kagent deployment
steps.description:
Verify your kagent version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n kagent -l app.kubernetes.io/name=kagent
helm list -n kagent 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working kagent installation.

steps.title: Review kagent configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant kagent configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n kagent -l app.kubernetes.io/name=kagent
kubectl get configmap -n kagent -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=kagent
```

steps.title: Apply the fix for [FEATURE] Add cronjob for agents
steps.description:
I agree this is a super important feature, and I can't wait to have it. I do want to understand better why you decided against the following:
```
Cronjob running in kubernetes background, not an e2e kagent platform feature
It works but we hope to contribute it back, as it offers a better UX.
```

Based on some cursory research that seemed like a really easy way to pick up a lot of functionality for free.

See the source issue for community-verified solutions.

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n kagent -l app.kubernetes.io/name=kagent
kubectl get events -n kagent --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "[FEATURE] Add cronjob for agents" is functioning correctly.
